# authwise_issuer_preferred_binding (Resource)

The binding an issuer's mailed links use: the invitation accept, the password reset, the address verification (`Issuer.preferred_binding_id`, kit#911). Without it they use the issuer's first binding. Point it at the binding on the custom domain your applications sign in on, so an invitation's one-button accept leaves the person signed in where the application looks. A binding on a custom domain that is not `ACTIVE` when a link is built falls back to the first routable one.

It is a resource of its own because a binding names its issuer: the issuer naming the binding back would be a cycle. `authwise_issuer.preferred_binding_id` reads the value back. Destroying this resource sets the issuer back to its first binding, and so does deleting the binding, on kit's side; the next refresh then finds this resource gone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authwise_issuer" "login" {}

resource "authwise_issuer_domain_binding" "native" {
  issuer_id = authwise_issuer.login.issuer_id
  domain_id = authwise_domain.native.domain_id
}

# The custom domain the applications sign in on.
resource "authwise_issuer_domain_binding" "custom" {
  issuer_id = authwise_issuer.login.issuer_id
  domain_id = authwise_domain.custom.domain_id
}

# Mailed links (an invitation's accept, a password reset) use the custom
# host, so the person ends up signed in where the application looks.
resource "authwise_issuer_preferred_binding" "login" {
  issuer     = authwise_issuer.login.name
  binding_id = authwise_issuer_domain_binding.custom.issuer_domain_binding_id

  # Optional: switch only once the host serves. kit builds links on the
  # first routable binding until the custom domain is ACTIVE either way.
  depends_on = [authwise_domain_activation.custom]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_id` (String) One of the issuer's bindings (`idb-…`), `authwise_issuer_domain_binding.<name>.issuer_domain_binding_id`. kit refuses another issuer's.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer's full resource name, `authwise_issuer.<name>.name`. Changing it sets the old issuer back to its first binding.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The issuer's full resource name.
terraform import authwise_issuer_preferred_binding.login tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01
```
